ganttRoleSwitchDirtyText: The selected role has unsaved Gantt changes. Switch without saving?
planningRolesNoSprint: Pick a sprint in the widget header or create a new one to plan role load.
planningRolesNoActive: ⚠️ No functional roles selected. Open the settings widget and pick at least one role.
planningPeopleNoSprint: Pick a sprint in the widget header or create a new one.
planningPeopleEmptyTitleTpl: No assignees picked for role «{role}» yet
planningPeopleEmptyDesc: Click the button below to load the current list of assignees from the Assignee field bundle.
roleSwitchDirtyText: Role «{role}» has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you switch. Continue?
lblHistoricalReadonlyHint: Sprint is in view-only mode. Click «Open for editing» to make changes.
hintDtaWarnings: When enabled, the workflow emits per-role plan-vs-fact progress messages on each work-item logging: under 90% — informational ratio, 90-100% — warning that less than 10% of the plan remains, over 100% — overrun alert. The role label and advice text are localised. Disable this checkbox if you only need the silent fact-field aggregation.
hintDta: When enabled, the bundled workflow rule aggregates issue work items by type and writes the result into per-role fact-fields according to the mapping below. Each work item type may be mapped to a single role only.
dtaErrDuplicate: A work item type cannot be mapped to two different roles. Remove the duplicate row before saving.
errDuplicateEstField: ⚠ The same estimate field cannot be selected for two different roles. Each role must point to its own period field.
errDuplicateFactField: ⚠ The same fact field cannot be selected for two different roles. Each role must point to its own period field.
hintSsbInline: Direct editing of issue fields in the planner table (dynEditEnabled).
hintSsbDta: Differentiated time accounting workflow active — work items are aggregated into per-role fact-fields.
hintSsbCascade: Cascade aggregation parent ← child active — child plan/fact fields roll up into level-2/level-3 parents.
dtaEmptyTable: No mappings yet. Click «+ Add mapping» to add one.
cardCascade: Cascade aggregation of estimates and work hours
hintCascade: When enabled, the bundled workflow rule sums per-role plan/fact fields (derived from DTA Fields → Estimate/Fact mapping) from child issues into their level-2/level-3 parents along the configured parent link. Hierarchy max 2 levels (task → level-2 → level-3).
lblForbidContainer: Forbid direct work-item logging on container issues
hintForbidContainer: When enabled, saves are rejected if a user tries to add or edit work items on issues whose kind matches a level-2 or level-3 container value. Time logging must happen on leaf child issues only.
warnCascadeWithoutForbid: ⚠ Cascade is on while forbid is off: any direct work-item logged on a container issue will be overwritten by the next cascade aggregation. Enable «Forbid direct logging» to keep aggregated values consistent.
hintCascadeLevel3Optional: Leave empty if you only need 1-step aggregation (task → level-2). When set, cascade extends to level-3 (level-2 → level-3).
warnCascadeLevelsOverlap: ⚠ Level-2 and level-3 must not share a value — overlap is ambiguous and breaks aggregation.
hintCascadeLinks: Defaults match the built-in YouTrack «Subtask» link type (inward «subtask of», outward «parent for»). Override only if your project uses a custom relation. Both directions must be filled.
hintDefaultLang: Applied to users who have not picked a personal language. Leave empty to fall back to the user's browser preference (or RU as the legacy default).
hintExternalTicketId: Select the YouTrack string field that stores the ticket ID in the external system (Service Desk, Jira, 1C, SAP, …). Once saved, a read-only column with that ID will appear in task tables.
hintHistClearGroup: Only members of this group can completely clear the entire sprint history of the project.
hintAssignerGroup: Members can change task assignees and start/end dates without full edit rights. Hierarchy: editor⊃assigner⊃viewer.
toastNoHistClearRights: Insufficient rights to clear sprint history
overlimitModalBody: Current allocation exceeds the available resource. To fix it, reduce allocations or raise the resource. If you leave it as is — the sprint status will be downgraded to Draft and require re-validation.
overlimitModalBodyTpl: Current allocation for role "{role}" exceeds the available resource. To fix it, reduce allocations or raise the resource. If you leave it as is — the sprint status will be downgraded to Draft and require re-validation.
toastOverlimitDowngraded: Sprint status downgraded due to overlimit. Fix and re-validate.
tooltipRowLocked: Sprint is distributed. Use "Open for edit" in history to modify.
toastAllocatedLockHint: Sprint is distributed — table is read-only. To edit, open the sprint from history with "Open for edit".
lblDynEdit: Direct editing of YouTrack issue fields from sprint table
tooltipDynEdit: When enabled, the sprint table gains extra columns (Fact, Resource, Allocation) and the State/System/Priority/XPriority cells become editable with direct write-back to YouTrack issues. Be mindful of YouTrack API load on bulk edits.
descDynEdit: When enabled: the "Refresh task data" button is hidden; table fields become interactive. Changes are applied to YouTrack tasks with confirmation.
lblPersonalRes: Use personal planning for automatic total resource calculation
descPersonalRes: When enabled, manual resource input on the "Overall Load Planning" tab is replaced by a calculated value based on the team composition.
descPersonalMode: Enables the "Task Distribution" tab and resource calculation by assignee.
bannerCfg: ⚠️ One or more previously selected fields have been removed or changed type. Please fix the configuration.
bannerNoSettings: ⚠️ Plugin settings are not filled in. Go to the Settings tab.
bannerNoRoles: ⚠️ No functional roles selected. Please choose at least one role in Settings.
ganttReassignNoRights: You don't have rights to reassign tasks.
ganttReassignDisabledByInlineEdit: Enable inline editing of YouTrack fields in settings to reassign tasks on the Gantt chart.
toastLogEmpty: Log is empty — nothing to export.
lblHideDiagLogUi: Hide diagnostic log panel from UI
hintHideDiagLogUi: When checked, the «Diagnostic log» block at the bottom of the widget is hidden. Events still go to memory and are available through TXT export after unchecking.
hintWcIndicator: A working copy exists — click to open editing
wcCloseBody: You have an in-progress edit for the current sprint/role. Changes are auto-saved — you can resume later from History.
wcSpoilerNotice: This is an in-progress edit by {who}, {when}
currentRoleNoSprintSelected: Select a sprint in the widget header
currentRoleNoRolesForSprint: No role records in history for the selected sprint
emptyAssignees: Select a sprint and click “Pick Assignees”
ganttDblClickHint: Double-click a bar to toggle color (red ↔ blue)
emptyGantt: Select a sprint and assign tasks to team members
btnExportHistoryTitle: Download all sprint history as JSON
btnImportHistoryTitle: Load sprint history from a JSON file
importHistCrossFork: ℹ File from another plugin fork ({fork}). Import is allowed.
importHistCrossInstance: ⚠ File from a different YouTrack instance. Task links point to the source instance.
importHistVersionWarn: ⚠ Plugin version in file ({v}) is newer than installed. Data loss is possible.
btnImportReplaceTitle: Clears all history and replaces with file content (requires historyManager role)
importReplaceWarn: ⚠ This will erase all current history and replace it with the file contents.
toastHistImportInvalid: File is not a sprint history export
draftSavedAtTitle: Local draft in browser. Use “Clear draft” to reload the server version.
btnClearDraftTitle: Delete local draft and load server version
clearDraftConfirmBody: All unsaved changes will be lost. The server version stays intact.
toastDraftStale: Server data was updated by another user — draft is not applied
toastDraftQuotaExceeded: Browser local storage quota exceeded — clear the draft
toastDraftTooLarge: Draft is too large for local storage
modalClearHistWarn: ⚠ This action will permanently delete all history records.
clearAllHistWarn: ⚠ This action will permanently delete all history records.
modalClearHistInfo: Data is stored in YouTrack and cannot be restored. Continue?
clearAllHistInfo: Data is stored in YouTrack and cannot be restored. Continue?
confirmClearTask: Remove all tasks from the current sprint (role)?
confirmClearAssignees: Clear the entire assignee list? Task assignments will be preserved.
confirmDelHist: Delete history record? It will be restored on next validation.
confirmFinishSprint: Mark sprint as “Closed”? This action is irreversible.
titlePickAll: Select all results across all pages
toastPickAllLimit: Loaded {n} tasks. Limit reached — refine the query to select more.
toastPickPageMetaLost: Metadata for some tasks is lost — repeat the search
toastXlsxErr: XLSX library not loaded. Check your network connection.
toastAssigneesEmpty: Assignee list is empty. Click “Pick Assignees” first.
toastSelectRoleFirst: Select sprint role before picking assignees.
toastNoUserField: No user field set for role “{role}” — go to Settings → User Fields by Role.
toastPickEmpty: Field bundle contains no users. Check field settings in YouTrack.
toastDateError: End date cannot be before start date
overlimitTooltip: Allocation of one or more tasks exceeds the task resource (delta)
thSortClickHint: Click to sort by this column (click again to disable).
toastSyncFromYtNoField: Assignee field is not configured for the role.
excelDiffHighlightLegend: Column “Δ” marks rows that differ between sheets (assignee, dates, estimate, allocation, inclusion).
compSprintEmpty: Sprint composition is empty. Click "+ Pick Tasks".
currentRoleCalcEmpty: Select a sprint and click "Calculate Resource"
tooltipNoRightsEdit: Insufficient rights. Sprint editing group required.
tooltipNoRightsVal: Insufficient rights. Sprint validation group required.
btnOpenSettingsTitle: Open plugin settings (available to members of the settings management group)
bannerNotConfigured: ⚠️ Plugin not configured. Project admin must set the management group in Project Settings → Apps → Sprint Planner.
btnCloseSettingsTitle: Close settings and return to planning
settingsNotConfiguredHint: Project admin must set the settings management group in Project Settings → Apps → Sprint Planner. Until then, the plugin is in read-only mode.
settingsNoAccessHint: Contact your project admin. Plugin settings management is restricted to a dedicated group.
overlimitWarnSrv: Server: resource overlimit detected for role {role}
nkcCrossMonthWarn: ⚠️ Sprint crosses month boundary. Verify the selected standard hours.
wcLevel_ALLOCATED_REVAL: Allocations changed — re-validation up to «Distributed» required
wcLevel_CONFIRMED_REVAL: Composition or estimates changed — re-validation up to «Composition agreed» required
wcDiffNoChanges: No diff — working copy is identical to the snapshot.
wcDiscardConfirmBody: All unsaved changes in the working copy will be lost. The base history record is not affected.
wcDiscardedToast: Working copy discarded. The base snapshot was not modified.
wcConflictBody: The base snapshot was modified ({who}) after this working copy was opened.
wcMultiTabBody: This working copy is being edited in another tab. Continue here? Changes from the other tab may be overwritten.
wcMigrationNotice: Unfinished v5.2 edit was committed as a draft. In v5.3, edits no longer destroy validated snapshots — use «Open for editing» to create a working copy.
wcStorageQuotaExceeded: Working-copies storage quota reached. Discard old unfinished edits.
descManualPersonalRes: When enabled, per-assignee resource in the «Resources by assignee» table is entered manually in hours instead of auto-calc by grade. Grade remains informational only.
hintStateRollup: When enabled, the bundled workflow rule recomputes container State (Story / Epic) as the least-progressed state across child issues whenever any child State changes. Reuses the hierarchy config from «Cascade aggregation» above. Disable if you have custom state-propagation workflows.
hintStateRollupNoHierarchy: ⚠ Rollup needs hierarchy config from «Cascade aggregation» above (kind field + level-2 / level-3 values). Fill that section first.
hintStateRollupOrder: Select states from the project bundle and order them from «least progressed» (Open / Backlog) at the top to «most progressed» (Done / Closed) at the bottom. The rollup picks the topmost state across all children. Minimum 2 states.
warnStateRollupOrderShort: ⚠ State order must contain at least 2 states.
lblStateRollupResolved: Resolved states (won’t be reopened by rollup)
hintStateRollupResolved: When a container is already in any of these states, rollup will not change it back. Typically: Done, Cancelled. Leave empty to disable the guard (containers will follow children even after closing).
hintStateRollupFloor: Containers won’t drop below this state even if children would push them lower. Use to keep Epics out of «Backlog» once analysis has started.
hintStateRollupStrategy: v1.7.0 supports «min» only. «max» (any-progressed) and «mode» (majority) are reserved for future releases.
hintStateRollupRescan: Forces a one-time recomputation across all level-2 / level-3 containers in this project. Use after enabling rollup for the first time or after a bulk state change. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
stateRollupRescanQueued: Rescan queued. Workflow will process all containers shortly.
toastStateRollupRescanFailed: Rescan request failed. Check workflow status.
phSprintGoal: What the team wants to achieve by sprint end
hintSprintGoal: One or two lines. Not a task list — an outcome.
toastSprintGoalMissing: Sprint goal is empty — consider adding one
phGoalRetroNote: What worked / didn't work toward this goal
hintStandupDoneStates: Tasks in these states appear in the Done bucket. If empty, the last 2 positions of State Rollup order are used.
standupNoSprint: Pick a sprint in the widget header or create a new one.
standupEmptyRole: No tasks in this role. Add tasks in «Roles».
standupGoalMissing: Sprint goal is not set. Add it in the Sprint Intro card.
standupNoDoneStatesHint: Configure Done states in Settings → Stand-up to populate the Done bucket.
